status: source_contract_verified; per-window raw checks remain mandatory
scope: Pinned single-frontend text-only Pro P/D, prefix disabled, no external cache, C1/C4, one closed-loop client, no unrelated requests.
observer_status: Startup-only receipts are incomplete and are not used as peak evidence.

sources.supports: Physical usage equals one minus free blocks divided by all non-null blocks. Source-held pages remain allocated and therefore visible.
Manager usage delegates directly to the physical block pool.
Every logged core output carries current scheduler usage to its frontend, including outputs with finished requests.
Prometheus record sets the per-engine usage gauge before incrementing per-engine finished-request counters.
Frontend processes each core output and records its scheduler and completion statistics in order; logging is synchronous.
Request completion and finished statistics are derived from the same core output.

required_window_checks: Warmup futures all return successfully before metrics-before; measured requests start only after the snapshot.
All eight P engine exact Prometheus usage gauges equal 0.0; running and waiting equal zero. Rounded log percentages are insufficient.

Per-engine before completion counters equal every request issued through the drained warmup; every prior measured window and warmup is accounted for, with no retry, abort or error. This excludes uninitialized or stale initial gauges.

Single frontend retains each engine output order; completion accounting and physical usage originate in the same core outputs. At the drained snapshot there are no new admissions; deferred source cleanup can only release pages.
Per-engine after-minus-before successful completions equal all measured admissions (16 for each P engine), with 128 exact 1024/1024 successful records and no hidden admissions.
Use the actual C1/C4 workload for D and Replay capacity; do not replace a C4 bound with C1.
Check zero preemptions and errors separately; no observed peak is inferred from these counters.

bound.reason: The source physical pool is empty at the drained boundary. Retain every block of all 16 subsequently admitted requests until window end, including every sliding group and the conservative async/proposal lookahead allowance. No source release during the measured window is assumed.
bound.limitations: This proof is per window, not cumulative since startup. It depends on exact-zero drained boundary and complete admission accounting; it does not qualify prefix-enabled, external-cache, unrelated-traffic or nonzero-boundary runs.
